findings.title: Cross-Sectional Heterogeneity in LSTM Networks for Financial Time Series (Julius Dobelt)
findings.note: Zero prior hits in wiki/ or dream_cycle/ (checked via grep for the arXiv ID, author name, and 'sector embedding'). Learnable sector embeddings + explicit industry-momentum and short-term-reversal factors in an LSTM long-short S&P 500 strategy, reported to beat basic-LSTM/RF/buy-and-hold baselines. Directly relevant because it independently arrives -- via the opposite mechanism (model sector as a feature vs. strip it out) -- at the same conclusion H199 and H313 already reached on this wiki: sector is signal, not noise. Staged as a wiki research note (low risk) on momentum-strategies.md, not a new hypothesis number -- a faithful test needs a from-scratch sector-parameterized LSTM, out of scope for tonight, and the abstract doesn't disclose numeric Sharpe.
